obligations.target: Rendered main page view displaying parameter input fields for parameterised endpoints
obligations.reason: Proves that the main page view generates input fields alongside API calls that support parameters.

obligations.target: API call execution handler with a user-supplied parameter and response output rendering
obligations.reason: Proves that executing an API call with a single parameter passes the parameter value and returns the resulting content.

obligations.target: API call execution handler incorporating multiple parameters and response rendering
obligations.reason: Proves that executing an endpoint with multiple parameters includes all provided parameters and presents the combined results.

obligations.target: Validation logic preventing execution and displaying required parameter error
obligations.reason: Proves that triggering an API call missing a required parameter prevents execution and shows a required validation indication.

obligations.target: Execution handler processing updated parameter values and refreshing output
obligations.reason: Proves that modifying the parameter value and re-running executes with the new parameter and displays the updated result.

obligations.target: Encoding and parameter handling for inputs containing special characters and spaces
obligations.reason: Proves that special characters and spaces within parameter inputs are correctly preserved during execution and displayed in the response.
